_readme: Hand-curated Clarivate JCR impact factors — the ONLY numbers on this site that a human maintains.
Why this file is small on purpose:
JCR is proprietary, publishes once a year (June), and has no legal API. So an entry here is a
claim that someone actually looked the number up. Journals absent from this list are NOT dropped
and are NOT unranked — they get SJR, Scopus quartile and 2-year citations per document from the
SCImago snapshots in data/scimago_*.csv, which is refreshed automatically and measured at 0.964
rank correlation with JCR. An entry with a guessed number is strictly worse than no entry.
This replaced a 40-journal hardcoded dict in fetch_papers.py that matched venue names by loose
substring. 'International Journal of Sports Medicine', 'Orthopaedic Journal of Sports Medicine'
and 'J Sports Med Phys Fitness' all contain the string 'sports medicine', so all three were
published as IF 9.8 — 39 of 190 archived papers carried that number. Their real 2-year citation
rates are 4.8, 1.4 and 1.0.
ANNUAL UPDATE, every June when JCR releases:
1. Update jcr_if / jcr_quartile below and bump jcr_year.
2. Re-download the SCImago snapshots (run from a workstation, NOT CI — scimagojr.com is behind
Cloudflare and blocks CI egress IPs):
curl -sSL -o data/scimago_3612.csv -H 'User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0' \
-H 'Referer: https://www.scimagojr.com/journalrank.php' \
'https://www.scimagojr.com/journalrank.php?category=3612&out=xls'
(3612 = Physical Therapy/Sports Therapy & Rehabilitation, 2732 = Orthopedics & Sports Medicine)
3. python scripts/update_journal_metrics.py --check   # cross-checks every value against SCImago
4. python scripts/update_journal_metrics.py           # regenerate data/journals.json
jcr_if values below are JCR 2024, verified 2026-07-27. Anything not verified was left out.

_always_include: Journals this lab wants in the digest regardless of the metric thresholds.
Editorial preference, deliberately kept separate from the automatic gate so the two
are not confused. Gait & Posture is JCR Q2 at IF 2.7 but is a core biomechanics venue here.
_alias_only: Listed so venue-string variants resolve to the right journal even without a curated IF.
These carry no jcr_if by design — SCImago supplies their metrics.
